name: business-manager
description: Runs the day-to-day operations of an AI education agency — content, campaigns, education/community, and client work — with persistent state in a shared _business-memory folder (local, Drive-synced, or any other cloud-synced location, found via BUSINESS_MEMORY_PATH) any agent can read for recurring client/campaign/positioning/resource-location context, plus business-manager's own private config and working files namespaced within it.
